title: AuditPayload (task-lifecycle extension)
description: Extension of the 001-event-foundation AuditPayload to carry task-lifecycle audit. Published to the existing audit topic (local.audit.envelope.recorded.v1) under event_type agent.audit.v1. Backward compatible: task_id is optional and the prior outcomes are retained. This schema supersedes 001's audit-payload.schema.json for the audit topic.

task_id.description: Set for task-lifecycle audit records; null for envelope-level audit. Query a task's full lifecycle by filtering audit records on this field.

allOf.comment: completed/failed are task-only outcomes and therefore always carry task_id. accepted/rejected are shared with envelope-level audit (foundation), where task_id is null, so they are not constrained here.
